title: Priv EKS: serial upgrade-safe Terraform blueprint with staged health probes
creator: Ava Nguyen
description:
Goal: Provide a Terraform module and operational pattern for provisioning Redwood Private EKS control-planes that support serial (one-step-at-a-time) upgrades, explicit preflight validations, and staged health probes so we can perform safe OS/AMI and k8s patch rollouts without impacting customer SLAs.

This ticket covers the module API, preflight checks, canary nodepool orchestration, drain-and-rejoin hooks, and observability hooks (CloudWatch/Grafana metrics + Console rollout status). The module must be consumable by Private deployments (VPC) and integrate with our existing AMI baking and SSM parameter store patterns. It should emit structured upgrade events to the audit log and include deterministic rollback wiring via Terraform outputs + a documented runbook.

Non-goals: full CI for AMI baking (that is tracked separately) and changes to Dedicated autoscaler logic.

Why: Current upgrade patterns are brittle for control-plane node rotations and we have seen customer regressions when multiple nodepools are cycled concurrently. A serial, probe-driven approach reduces blast radius and makes automated rollbacks safe and observable.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published at modules/priv/eks-controlplane-blueprint with documented inputs/outputs and examples
Can perform a serial control-plane nodepool upgrade using only Terraform (no manual kubectl steps) with automated preflight and postflight checks
Upgrade run emits rollout events to audit logs and a Console rollout status is viewable for the cluster
Automated rollback path validated in staging (terratest scenario recorded) and sample runbook added to docs
Health probes detect degraded API-server latency and automatically suspend the next rotation step; metrics surface in Grafana dashboard
tasks: Design module inputs: control_plane_ami, nodepool_strategy, preflight_checks_enabled, kms_key_arn
Implement Terraform resources and null_resource hooks for drain/rejoin with retries
Add preflight validations (vpc/subnet checks, node IAM role checks, KMS access) with clear error messages
Wire CloudWatch metrics and CloudWatch->Grafana dashboard panels for rollout visibility
Create terratest suite: simulate slow kube-apiserver and validate pause/resume behavior
Open GitHub PR and request infra + security review
Smoke test upgrade on staging cluster and record artifacts (plan/apply logs, metrics screenshots)
